why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Infernet node operators: "Operators who ran those nodes are eligible, weighted by uptime (and purpose!) and workloads served."
Frenrug users: "Users who held keys and pitched the agent are eligible subject to the same scrutiny around any botted behavior."
Community members: "Long-time community members, including those consistently active in the Discord and ambassadors who helped grow it, are eligible."
costs: There's no claim fee, but you need RITUAL on Ritual Mainnet before you can claim, and the Foundation hasn't published an official route to get it there. The docs only say: "You need RITUAL for transaction gas and for RitualWallet deposits that back async precompile calls." No deposit, purchase or minimum is part of the claim itself.
risks: You must be 18 or older. Sanctioned people are excluded, along with anyone "located, a resident of or organized in any jurisdiction or territory that is the subject of comprehensive country-wide or regional economic sanctions".
